checkedAlternates.risk: ANSI A is roughly similar in size to A4.
checkedAlternates.resolution: ANSI A follows the US inch standard (group-1), not the ISO 216 A-series (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: C4 is sized to hold an unfolded A4 sheet.
checkedAlternates.resolution: C4 and C5 belong to the ISO C envelope series (group-2), whose dimensions are geometric means of A and B.
